title: Iran and the U.S. lean into gunboat diplomacy as nuclear talks hang in balance
summary: Iran and the United States leaned into gunboat diplomacy Thursday, with Tehran holding drills with Russia and the Americans bringing another aircraft carrier closer to the Mideast.
contentText:
